# ELIV8 LYF FZE — AI Consulting
# https://eliv8lyf.com

## About
ELIV8 LYF FZE is an AI-native consulting firm registered in the UAE Free Zone (FZE), specialising in AI strategy, implementation, and transformation for businesses across the Middle East, Africa, and globally.

## Services
- AI Strategy & Roadmapping: Business opportunity assessment, phased AI adoption roadmaps, ROI modelling
- AI Implementation & Integration: LLM deployment, ML pipelines, intelligent APIs, cloud-native infrastructure
- Generative AI & Creative Automation: Content generation systems, creative workflows, brand-safe AI automation
- AI Training & Change Management: Team upskilling, AI literacy programmes, change management
